en: Although invisible, the air inside a balloon has measurable mass and takes up physical space.
When a solid ice cube melts into liquid water, its total mass remains exactly the same.
Liquid water evaporates into water vapor at room temperature, not only when it reaches its boiling point.
Dissolving sugar in water does not destroy the sugar, because the sugar can be recovered through evaporation.
Rusting is a chemical change because iron reacts with oxygen to form an entirely new substance.
Not all metals are magnetic, as materials like copper, gold, and aluminum are not attracted to magnets.
Once liquid water reaches its boiling point, its temperature stays at exactly 100 degrees Celsius until fully vaporized.
A massive steel ship floats on water because its hollow shape gives it a lower overall density than water.
Clouds are not made of invisible water vapor, but rather consist of visible liquid water droplets or ice crystals.
Breaking a solid piece of chalk into smaller powder is a physical change because no new substance is formed.
Saltwater is a mixture rather than a pure substance because the salt and water can be physically separated.
Gases do not lack volume; instead, a gas expands to completely fill the entire volume of its container.
